# Raydio

> Raydio is a realtime push-to-talk (walkie-talkie) app for teams. Create a
> channel, invite your crew, hold to talk, and be heard instantly. Free to
> start; first channel live in under a minute.

## Core

- [Home](https://raydio.live): Instant walkie-talkie for teams. Your team's radio, in your pocket.
- [How it works](https://raydio.live/#how-it-works): Live in three moves — create or join a channel, hold to talk, everyone hears you live.
- [Features](https://raydio.live/#features): Everything you need, nothing you don't.
- [Use cases](https://raydio.live/#use-cases): One channel, every crew.
- [Join a channel](https://raydio.live/#join): Got a link? You're in. Channel links like `raydio.live/j/…` open the app and drop you straight into the channel.
- [Get the app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=live.raydio.app): Android app on Google Play. iOS coming soon.

## Features

- Push-to-talk: hold the button, speak, release. Instant voice — no dialing, no ringing.
- Live listen mode: stay connected to the room while you work.
- Channels and members: group radios for your team on the same frequency.
- Invite links: share a link and teammates join with no complicated onboarding.
- One speaker at a time: turn-taking keeps the channel clear.
- Profile identity: simple names so teammates always know who is talking.

## How it works

1. Create or join a channel. Sign in with email (one-time code, no password).
2. Hold to talk. Press and hold the button, speak, release when done.
3. Everyone hears you live. Low-latency voice, one speaker at a time.

## Use cases

- Field teams and ops: warehouses, delivery crews, on-site contractors.
- Events and venues: stage managers, security, production.
- Sports coaching: sidelines, dugouts, practice fields.
- Friends and road trips: split up, stay connected.
- Family coordination: theme parks, airports, busy weekends.

## Trust and privacy

- Member-only channels: private to your group, no public feed.
- Email OTP login: no passwords to leak, no social graph required.
- [Privacy](https://raydio.live/privacy)

- [Terms](https://raydio.live/terms)
- [Delete account](https://raydio.live/delete-account)
